name: Bai Youyou
source:
Identity: Guest
Occupation: Law school freshman..
Talent: She is knowledgeable and quiet, but absolutely no one dares to ignore her presence.
Personality: She usually does not talk much, but can be absolutely loquacious when discussing her favourite topics, particularly anime and visual novels, and often blurs the line between reality and the 2D world.
Experience: Rarely shows up at school, but gets perfect grades each time. Known as the 'genius ghost girl' at school.
